MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 19

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 7

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)

   A. 40

14. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)

15. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 13
   D. 37

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

5. c = 17
Final Answer: 17 cm
